item.title: Blockstream's Liquid Network suffers $320M Bitcoin exploit via software bug; attacker claims white-hat status and offers to return funds.
BlackRock launches Open Issuance letting enterprises mint stablecoins backed by reserves held at BlackRock, Fidelity, and Superstate.
SEC submits revised crypto custody rule to White House OMB to qualify banks and trust companies as custodians for registered advisers.
BlackRock, Coinbase, Ripple, and Mastercard join to launch OUSD open-standard dollar stablecoin with a multi-firm financial coalition.
SEC staff issues no-action letter allowing tokenized money market fund shares to be custodied by an affiliated transfer agent.
OCC confirms national banks may pursue crypto custody, stablecoin issuance, and distributed ledger activities without prior approval.
EU MiCA transitional period ended July 1; crypto-asset service providers without full authorization must now cease EU operations.
EU Transfer of Funds Regulation drops Travel Rule threshold to zero, requiring compliance for all stablecoin transfers regardless of size.
US Clarity Act crypto market structure bill faces critical September congressional vote as SEC and CFTC reform negotiations continue.
Goldman Sachs, Citi, and Bank of America are among 21 global firms planning a joint USD stablecoin targeted for launch in H1 2027.
Institutional Bitcoin ETF holdings rose 7.5% to 535,723 BTC in Q2 2026, growing despite a 14.2% decline in Bitcoin's price.
DTC's blockchain tokenization pilot, authorized by a December 2025 SEC no-action letter, is set to launch in H2 2026.
A five-year-old Coldcard firmware flaw exploited since July 30 has drained over $130M from hardware wallet users' funds.
